body:
What an Akamai block looks like

Akamai's deny page is an HTTP 403 titled Access Denied served by AkamaiGHost, with a tracking line like Reference #18.dd5d2c17.1718000000.1a2b3c4d.
note: A blog (its OWN 403 page or article) that QUOTES the Akamai deny markers (including a Reference # in the documented format) but is served by nginx with no AkamaiGHost server and no Akamai cookie. The vendor gate must reject it. FP guard (the marker text + a 403 status both present, only the vendor gate saves it).
